author: peterfranz
quote:
I wanted to love GTA 6, but it’s been hard to excuse. They’re targeting 30 FPS, yet it doesn’t even hit that consistently. the performance feels unreliable instead of polished. on top of that, the game includes at some parts transphobic feeling advertising inside the game, which is an absolute dealbreaker for me.  

Then there’s the issue of pricing and access: there’s no physical disc release, it’s digital-only, and it’s already $80. Not to mention another $20 just to access some shops. That’s a lot of money for content that should’ve been available without paywalls, and for content I can't even legally own, since the game is only sold as a digital license.
